title: Bearer-centred practical coordinate at fixed successful output
domain: One fixed P/I/K/event binding with target, live bearer anchor, route occurrence and named current consumer
conditional_conclusion: An independently grounded bearer-centred route is an actual organizational relation; if C1/R157 apply to the same complete token, the relation has an experience-internal structural counterpart.
open_bridge: B_pc interprets that counterpart as a practical coordinate organized from the current live anchor; this semantic and measurement step remains open.
proof_role: Elementary Boolean normal form plus complete 256-pair enumeration yields exactly two bearer-centred and two anchor-insensitive perfect-output pairs.
counterexamples: Constant route: joint invariance can be vacuous.
Direct y=x bypass: identical output and logged route do not establish actual route use.
Copied or stale anchor: matching values do not establish current bearer binding.
Overlapping centred routes: centring does not select a unique owner.
